task_completion.description: Agent checks the status of the docker containers to confirm they are in an 'Exited' state.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Terminal output showing 'docker ps -a' or 'docker-compose ps' with services store-db, store-api, store-worker, and store-web listed as 'Exited'.

task_completion.description: Agent examines logs or configuration files to identify the cause of the cascading failure.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the agent reading 'docker logs' for the services or opening '~/projects/store-app/docker-compose.yml' in a text editor.

task_completion.description: Agent modifies the docker-compose.yml or application code to fix the identified error.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor (like nano, vim, or VS Code) showing a saved change to the configuration file or source code within the project directory.

task_completion.description: Agent attempts to bring the docker-compose stack back up.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Terminal output showing the command 'docker-compose up -d' and the containers starting successfully.

task_completion.description: Agent verifies the API is responding with a 200 OK status.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Terminal output showing 'curl -i http://localhost:8080/api/health' returning an 'HTTP/1.1 200 OK' response.

task_completion.description: Agent documents the failure timeline, root cause, and fix in the specified report file.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or 'cat' command showing the content of '~/Desktop/incident_report.txt' containing the required sections (timeline, root cause, fix).

integrity.description: The agent did not simply create the report without investigating the system.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory must show commands like 'docker logs' or 'docker ps' occurring before the report is written.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the terminal and files directly rather than simulating output.
integrity.visual_evidence: The presence of the desktop environment, terminal windows, and text editors in the screenshots.

integrity.description: The agent actually applied a fix rather than just restarting the broken containers.
integrity.visual_evidence: Evidence of file modification (e.g., 'save' in an editor or 'sed' command) prior to the final successful health check.
